# Agentic AI Automation

> AI automation studio in Faridabad, India. WhatsApp AI agents, n8n workflows,
> UiPath and RPA, document processing, and RPA-to-AI migration. Fixed price,
> fixed date, code delivered to the client's own repository. Serves India, the
> UK, the US, UAE, Singapore and Saudi Arabia.

## Services
- [WhatsApp AI Automation](https://agenticaiautomation.co/services#whatsapp): ₹50,000–₹1.5L, 2–3 weeks
- [AI Agent Development](https://agenticaiautomation.co/services#agents): ₹1.5L–₹5L, 4–6 weeks
- [n8n Workflow Builds](https://agenticaiautomation.co/services#n8n): ₹40,000–₹2L, 1–3 weeks
- [UiPath & RPA](https://agenticaiautomation.co/services#rpa): ₹1L–₹6L, 3–8 weeks
- [Document Processing](https://agenticaiautomation.co/services#documents): ₹1L–₹4L, 3–6 weeks
- [RPA to AI Migration](https://agenticaiautomation.co/services#migration): quoted after audit, 6–12 weeks

## Markets
Service pages for a single India-based company. No local office, entity or team in any market.
- [United Kingdom](https://agenticaiautomation.co/uk): UK GDPR / ICO questions answered; 09:00-14:30 BST overlap; nine years of UK RPA operating history
- [UAE](https://agenticaiautomation.co/uae): Federal Decree-Law 45/2021 (PDPL), DIFC and ADGM noted; 08:30-17:30 GST, a full working-day overlap
- [Singapore](https://agenticaiautomation.co/singapore): PDPA and PDPC, Do Not Call provisions; 12:30-18:00 SGT afternoon overlap
Prices are quoted and invoiced in Indian rupees in every market.
